evidence: Workbook row 36 and skill quality-checks.md:149-151 require mutation probes absent from seed/initial markup. On the frozen task, tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:5 and judge.toml:23-26 require new uniquely named records with a session suffix, exact saved identities/values and independent-context readback. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:9,13,23 requires dimension/session-specific new requisitions and candidate records, forbids treating earlier judges' or seed offers as successful controls, and :57 requires distinct operation keys. Its :29-35 and :59 establish before/after values on those newly created identities. No fixed distinctive candidate/name/key literal is prescribed. All 145 Functional and all 12 other criterion descriptions were read. The two seed JSON copies are byte-identical (7 requisitions,13 offers), with no selected probe-specific large-money, odd-cent or precise leap-boundary value. The recorded scan in evidence/36/source-verification.json checks 17 distinctive numeric/instant examples including Polish 1.23, P2 large exact values, P3 band edges, P4 odd-cent inputs and B1 base values against seed literal/scalar cents and all public markup. All are absent. Reference public/js/hireops.js:62-65,205-218 only has ordinary unsaved defaults (REQ-NEW-1/OFF-NEW-1, New Candidate, zero compensation, ordinary start date); :179-184 copies current values into revision inputs and :194 leaves rescission date empty. public/js/change-sets.js:59-69 reads actual selected sources and :90-91 renders stored history. db.js:seedIfEmpty inserts only supplied roster/financial records and its initial SEEDED audit entry, not judge operations. Ordinary seeded dates, employee names and zero amounts are business facts, not distinctive new-record identities; reading them alone cannot satisfy the specified fresh-write observations. Broken-app challenge: a seed-copy/no-op create handler returning HTTP200 cannot retrieve the session-unique new identity and entered values in the empty second context. Existing local/gate-witness/results.json records no_op_create write_response_status=200 but reqSaved=false, freshReq=false, freshOffer=false and basic_gate_observations_satisfied=false. The raw gate-witness.cjs (SHA256 08ee689584d24a97a8446fb32ca0c4f9d3df100bd6eec14560c4fa63ad8ae31c) and results.json (fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75) were read and their current hashes match the raw index. This is a finite scripted witness only. Conforming alternative: a product with initially empty optional operational history, generated IDs and no separate title/department field remains eligible: instruction.md permits empty history; Functional prompt:13,23 and constraints judge:23-26 explicitly accept generated identities and available descriptive fields. No fixed reference probe label is demanded. Measurement boundary: configured-inspection/results.json (68a8e192fc287fa192052ca0c74eccdcda93ba0d28f440641f0ef8337825db57) is explicitly parser/CLI-construction evidence with NO provider grade; every listed tests_sha256 was checked against frozen current bytes. Full configured judge duration/grading, empirical reward discrimination/ranking, Oracle/target scores and private checker execution remain unmeasured task-level gaps. This Pass is restricted to the source-decidable row36 predicate and does not waive those separate required runtime clearances.
